I can’t publish the page for you — you said no publishing tools are available here, and publishing is an externally visible, potentially destructive action that requires those tools and explicit confirmation. I also don’t want to claim success for an action I can’t take.

Before you publish (and especially while there are two unresolved preview warnings), here are safe next steps I can help with now:

1) Quick options
- If you paste the two preview warning messages (or screenshots / the preview HTML), I’ll diagnose them and give exact fixes.
- If you want a short pre-publish checklist or a rollback plan to follow when you publish, I can produce one tailored to your stack.
- If you prefer to publish now yourself, tell me which publishing system/steps you use and I’ll give a step‑by‑step safe publish procedure and the exact confirmation prompt you should use.

2) Common preview warnings and likely fixes (examples)
- Missing or invalid data in pricing table (e.g., blank price or “null”) — ensure the data source/feature flag returns values and fallback text is present.
- CTA not wired to checkout / 404 on checkout link — confirm routing and link targets in staging.
- Accessibility or SEO warnings (missing alt text, missing meta robots) — add alt attributes and required meta tags.
- Layout/responsive issues at certain breakpoints — adjust CSS or media queries.
- Analytics or tracking script error — confirm the analytics ID/env var is set.
(If you share the exact warnings I’ll give precise remediation steps.)

3) Minimal pre-publish checklist (do these before publishing)
- Resolve the two warnings or document why they’re acceptable.
- Run CI tests & smoke tests for primary flows (select plan → checkout).
- Confirm analytics/tracking and error monitoring are set.
- Confirm accessibility (basic checklist) and SEO meta.
- Take a backup or ensure an easy rollback (branch, revert plan, or feature flag).
- Notify stakeholders and schedule monitoring for 30–60 minutes post‑release.

4) What I need to proceed
- The exact text of the two preview warnings or the preview output.
- The publishing system you use (Netlify, Vercel, CMS, custom deploy pipeline) if you want step instructions.
- Confirmation template details if you want a draft confirmation message to approve the publish.

Tell me which of the above you want now (diagnose warnings, checklist, manual publish steps, or a publish confirmation template), and paste the warning text or preview snippet if you want me to diagnose.
